Turnover index by sub-sector

Index, 2021 = 100, calendar-adjusted net turnover. Covers only 6 business-services sub-sectors (source table limitation) — excludes trade, financial services, and public services entirely. "Professional & scientific (partial)" excludes head offices/consultancy and R&D activities, unlike elsewhere on this site.

Compensation per employee, by sector

Thousand EUR per employee per year (current prices, not inflation-adjusted). "Total compensation" includes employer social contributions; "wages & salaries only" excludes them. Uses a coarser, pre-aggregated NACE grouping than the rest of the site (source table limitation) — sub-sectors here do not fully match the 11-sub-sector scheme used elsewhere.
